We're on a mission to transform how companies use data. Come be a part of our journey! About The Team The Managed Postgres team is building ClickHouse's fully managed Postgres service. It gives developers a fast, reliable Postgres that works natively alongside ClickHouse, so one platform covers both transactional and real-time analytical workloads. This is a strategic, high-visibility initiative, and the user experience we build will shape how thousands of developers create, manage, monitor, and scale their databases. About The Role We're looking for a Full Stack Software Engineer to help build responsive, performant, and elegant interfaces that make complex database operations feel simple. You'll work closely with product, design, and backend engineers, and you'll learn from senior engineers while owning real features from day one. What You'll Do Turn designs and user requirements into intuitive, high-quality interfaces for the Managed Postgres experience in ClickHouse Cloud. Build features end-to-end: React and TypeScript on the frontend, plus integration with (and contributions to) backend APIs. Build data-rich UIs for metrics, diagnostics, backups, replication, and performance insights. Contribute to click-ui, our open-source design system, and follow frontend best practices: code quality, performance, accessibility, and testing. Give product and design feedback from a developer's point of view. About You Experience: 1–4 years in frontend or full-stack development. Core skills: Solid React, TypeScript, and modern frontend fundamentals (state management, component architecture, data fetching). Backend exposure: Comfortable working with REST APIs; Node.js, Go, or similar is a plus. Collaboration: You enjoy working closely with designers and backend engineers across a global team. Developer empathy: You care about fast, clear, purposeful UIs for technical users. Ownership: You take initiative, ask good questions, and carry work from idea to delivery. Growth mindset: You're keen to learn and grow your scope quickly. Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare. Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options. Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries. A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee. Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites. Culture - We All Shape It As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture. Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.
